completed professional draft with separately reported neutral and contextual estimates
professional draft prefixes at champion-pick depths 0 through 9; depth 10 is terminal

population.league_membership_source: G1 competition crosswalk bound as-of each event

partition_template.overlap_rule: A row ID may occur in exactly one role within one opening decision; maps in one series share a partition.
partition_template.chronological_rule: train < validation < calibration < test < final within every rolling origin fold

primary_comparison.probability_clip: NONE; non-finite or closed-boundary probabilities invalidate the row and run

aggregation.level_1: equal-weight mean of map losses within resolved series
aggregation.level_2: equal-weight mean of resolved series within league x fold
aggregation.level_3: equal-weight mean across exactly LEC,LCK,LPL,LCS,LCP within fold
aggregation.level_4: equal-weight mean across registered chronological folds
aggregation.international_handling: separate named release-critical strata; never included in domestic macro-regional primary

primary_comparison.strict_superiority: Holm rejection plus unadjusted one-sided 95% WCR-inverted upper endpoint strictly below 0

diagnostics.definition: mean((p-y)^2) using the primary four-level aggregation
unpenalized logistic calibration y ~ 1 + offset(logit(p)); ideal 0
unpenalized logistic calibration y ~ 1 + beta*logit(p); ideal 1
diagnostics.support: both outcomes, finite logits, >=30 resolved series, no complete separation

diagnostics.definition: 10 fixed probability bins [0,.1),...,[.9,1], reporting count, mean p, observed rate and dependence-aware interval
diagnostics.support: empty bins retained and marked unsupported

diagnostics.definition: ROC AUC per league x fold then equal-weight macro; descriptive only
diagnostics.support: both outcomes in every included cell

diagnostics.definition: empirical coverage and average width for registered predictive intervals; posterior parameter intervals are not substituted
diagnostics.support: registered interval target and >=30 effective clusters

diagnostics.definition: log loss on first tournament of a newly assembled exact roster, plus first-series sensitivity
diagnostics.support: >=30 resolved series, >=30 effective clusters, and both outcomes

diagnostics.definition: Spearman rank correlation and top-10 Jaccard between adjacent scheduled refreshes on the common active population
log loss and Brier on masked-residual and genuinely unseen/new-champion strata, separately
diagnostics.support: >=30 resolved series, >=30 effective clusters, and both outcomes

diagnostics.definition: paired log-loss delta on preregistered near-equal-strength overlap rows
diagnostics.support: >=30 resolved series, >=30 effective clusters, and both outcomes

dependence.analysis_row: one paired candidate-minus-baseline mean loss difference per resolved series

cluster_dimensions.construction: connected component linking series that share a team or player and whose event starts are <=28 days apart
authoritative tournament ID; if absent, ISO UTC calendar week
major.minor patch, used as required shared-shock sensitivity

dependence.resampling: null-imposed wild cluster restricted bootstrap with exactly one selected bootstrap clustering dimension per run; each draw creates one pseudo-outcome vector, refits the weighted intercept, and recomputes the full active-dimension CGM covariance

minimum_effective_clusters.formula: Kish: (sum cluster series counts)^2 / sum(cluster series counts^2)

dependence.small_cluster_correction: for each selected bootstrap dimension use Webb six-point multipliers at 30-49 effective clusters and Rademacher multipliers at >=50; support below 30 blocks that run

algorithm.input_schema: exact per-series fields: series_id,fold_id,registered_fold_ids,league_id,candidate_id,baseline_id,output_id,stratum_id,score_kind,map_ids,candidate_probabilities,baseline_probabilities,outcome,macro_weight,participant_component_28d,tournament_or_week,patch,game_side,roster_change,international_event,draft_depth,exact_roster_id,series_order_within_exact_roster_tournament,strength_source_id,pre_outcome_candidate_strength,pre_outcome_baseline_strength,resolved,input_sha256,candidate_prediction_sha256,baseline_prediction_sha256,row_order_sha256; probabilities are paired with binary outcomes and every inferential critical cell contains both outcomes
algorithm.input_score: derive d_i from the registered score_kind (LOG_LOSS or BRIER), candidate probabilities, baseline probabilities, and binary outcomes for one resolved series; canonicalize by unique series_id
algorithm.macro_weights: derive w_i internally as 1/(F*5*n_fold,league) from bound ordered registered_fold_ids and league_id; every chronological fold contains exactly the five registered domestic leagues, sum_i w_i=1, and any submitted macro_weight must exactly match the derivation
algorithm.estimand: Delta=sum_i w_i*d_i; never a raw map-weighted or series-weighted mean
algorithm.active_variants: primary uses P,T; required patch sensitivity uses P,T,H; no two-way substitute when H is unsupported
algorithm.null_imposition: derive registered theta0 from immutable slot decision_kind and its registered margin rule (never caller supplied), fit the restricted null theta0, set e0_i=d_i-theta0, draw one multiplier v_b,g for the selected bootstrap dimension D, and construct d*_i=theta0+v_b,g_D(i)e0_i
algorithm.intersection_sets: every nonempty subset of the active dimensions; primary has P,T,PT and patch sensitivity has all seven P,T,H,PT,PH,TH,PTH
algorithm.intersection_cluster_id: length-prefixed UTF-8 concatenation of canonical cluster IDs in dimension order
algorithm.cluster_score: after the unrestricted observed fit use q_i=w_i(d_i-theta_hat); after every bootstrap refit use q*_i=w_i(d*_i-theta*_b); Q_S,g is the sum of q or q* in intersection cluster g and every G_S must be >=2
algorithm.covariance: V=sum_nonempty_S (-1)^(|S|+1)*c_S*sum_g Q_S,g^2 for the weighted intercept score; the same full active-dimension CGM expression is recomputed from bootstrap residuals
algorithm.multiplier_substream: u64be(HMAC-SHA-256(key='2026072901', message='mw-wcb-v2|A='+active_dimensions+'|bootcluster='+D+'|replicate='+decimal(r)+'|cluster='+canonical_g+'|law='+law)[:8]) modulo support length; no runtime RNG, subset multiplier, candidate ID, or comparison ID
algorithm.replicate_score: one multiplier field on selected D creates d* once; refit theta*=sum_i w_i d*_i and never form a signed sum of independently multiplied subset scores
algorithm.studentizer: from e*_i=d*_i-theta* recompute every Q*_S,g and the full V*=sum_S sign(S)c_S sum_g(Q*_S,g)^2; t*=(theta*-theta0)/sqrt(V*)
algorithm.bootstrap_t: (theta*_b-theta0)/sqrt(V*_b) after refitting and full active-dimension CGM re-studentization
algorithm.one_sided_upper_endpoint: invert the null-imposed lower-tail WCR test over theta0 with a deterministic verified bracket and monotonic bisection; a type-7 t* quantile endpoint is diagnostic only and cannot satisfy the gate
algorithm.largest_cluster_tie_break: largest resolved-series count, then lexicographically smallest canonical cluster ID
algorithm.leave_largest_recompute: for P, T, and H separately remove the selected cluster and fully recompute canonical rows, macro weights, fits, support, multiplier law, every primary P/T and patch P/T/H run, complete registered family p-value ordering, Holm ranks/rejections, unadjusted endpoints, and family decision
algorithm.replicate_alignment: replicate index r and authority-derived HMAC stream are shared across every comparison in a registered family; row sets may differ across harm and secondary cells

dependence.interval: one-sided 95% upper confidence bound obtained by null-imposed WCR test inversion; empirical type-7 bootstrap-t endpoints are diagnostic only
dependence.leave_largest_sensitivity: remove the largest cluster by series count in P, T, and H one dimension at a time and recompute the complete primary-plus-patch suite
dependence.decision_agreement: for every complete registered family, full primary A={P,T}, full patch A={P,T,H}, and all P/T/H leave-largest primary-plus-patch variants must remain available; each variant recomputes Holm ordering and requires Holm rejection plus agreement with its unadjusted endpoint, otherwise promotion is blocked

margin_derivation.replicate_definition: absolute difference in macro-regional chronological log loss between a reference baseline fit and a deterministic refresh/refit of the identical baseline specification on the identical evaluation rows
margin_derivation.statistic: Hyndman-Fan type-7 95th percentile of absolute paired replicate differences
margin_derivation.scope: separate margin per output x baseline
margin_derivation.replica_seed_schedule: replicate i has ID refresh-refit-%04d and seed 2026072902+i in array order

multiplicity.primary_family: one complete candidate-scoped family containing every registered output x required-baseline primary comparison
multiplicity.harm_family: one complete candidate-scoped family containing every applicable output x baseline x critical-cell slot; unavailable or low-support slots remain and block
multiplicity.secondary_family: one complete candidate-scoped family containing every output x baseline x preregistered secondary-benefit slot; all evidence is required and at least one member must pass
multiplicity.method: Holm step-down, one-sided, complete predeclared family; order by raw finite-p then immutable comparison ID; stop at first non-rejection
multiplicity.pass_coupling: Holm rejection plus agreement with an unadjusted one-sided 95% WCR-inverted endpoint is required; U<theta for superiority/components and U<=theta for noninferiority/harm

promotion.superiority_path: all complete primary-family members have Holm rejection and an agreeing unadjusted one-sided 95% WCR-inverted upper endpoint < 0 in every full and leave-largest primary/patch variant
promotion.noninferiority_secondary_benefit_path: UNAVAILABLE_UNTIL_A_SEPARATE_REGISTERED_MARGIN_THRESHOLD_PRIMARY_RULE_IS_FROZEN; zero-threshold primary evidence is never reused at a positive margin
promotion.material_harm: candidate-minus-baseline critical-stratum log-loss upper bound must be <= bound margin; while margin is deferred the threshold is 0

complexity.indistinguishable_rule: both candidates independently pass their complete primary, harm, and secondary families before pair authority; all 20 registered centered wild-cluster CGM max-t sensitivity runs must remain available, agree, and have simultaneous two-sided 95% bands containing 0; every full or reduced sample is centered at its own internally derived macro-weighted estimate; neither candidate is materially worse
complexity.simultaneous_interval_entry_point: lol_kills.v2.evaluation.benchmark_contract:compute_registered_pairwise_intervals; reports 20 separate centered wild-cluster CGM simultaneous max-t two-sided 95% bands, each centered at that full or reduced sample's own internally derived macro-weighted estimate and binding P/T/H plus PT/PH/TH/PTH intersections; not a pooled generic CI or inverted WCR endpoints
complexity.selection: choose lower numeric simplicity_rank among indistinguishable passing candidates
complexity.ablation_rule: every enabled named component must receive Holm rejection plus an agreeing unadjusted one-sided 95% WCR-inverted upper endpoint < 0 against its registered ablation; otherwise collapse to the supported parent or remove the component
complexity.nonzero_or_ambiguous_pair_interval: use interval sign for directional dominance; if no unique nondominated passing candidate return NO_WINNER_REMAND

authority_model.cooperative_process_claim_ceiling: The in-process verifier prevents ordinary caller injection but is not unforgeable against hostile same-process monkeypatching, same-account file substitution, or intercepted I/O.
required_external_boundary: separately owned verifier process without write access to authority or ledger roots
independently signed authority artifacts with verifier keys outside evidence-generator write access
append-only ledger service or separately owned durable exact-once store

digest_policy.semantic_digest: SHA-256 of RFC-8785-like sorted compact JSON used for semantic identity
digest_policy.raw_digest: SHA-256 of exact file bytes used to detect whitespace, encoding, or byte mutation
digest_policy.contract_set_digest: authority_contract_set_sha256 binds the noncyclic core rules and schemas; full contract_set_sha256 binds every package JSON including authority/candidate/pair registries plus executable authority-code raw bytes
